_doc: Daily health check-in. Thresholds and schedule for `health-ping`. Edit here, not in code — src/health.py is the only reader.

schedule._doc: Runs after the 08:00 daily analysis and 08:05 digest so the check-in reports on this morning's jobs rather than yesterday's. Timezone is the agent timezone; Amazon day boundaries stay on America/Los_Angeles regardless.

heartbeat._doc: The scheduler stamps this file every interval_minutes. It detects a WEDGED scheduler — a live process whose job threads have stopped. It cannot detect a dead process, because a dead scheduler also sends no check-in: total silence is that signal, and the operator should treat a missing morning message as a fault in itself.

thresholds._doc_ads_sync: 26h, not 24h: the ads sync runs daily at 05:00, so a 24h limit would flag a merely late run every time one slipped by minutes.
thresholds._doc_ads_data: Days between the newest ads_campaigns_daily row and the last closed Amazon day. Amazon reporting lags, so 1 day is normal.
thresholds._doc_sqp: SQP is weekly and published ~7 days in arrears, so anything under 10 days is current. Over that means the Monday sync is failing.

scoreboard._doc: Complete (closed) Amazon days, America/Los_Angeles, compared against the equally-sized window immediately before.

debounce._doc: One routine message per calendar day. A warning repeats only after repeat_warning_after_hours, UNLESS the fault set changes or severity rises — a new or worsening problem is never suppressed by a debounce window.
